Dialogs.Dialog: All right, I'll work hard again today！
Then again, I still need ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ to teach me...
Anegasaki
Hehe, do your best, okay？
Yup！
Here I go！
(Hmm, there are a lot of things to remember. Umm, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is...)
Otori
Anegasaki-san！ What was I supposed to do with this？
Ah, that's...
Komari
Nene-san～ Save mee～
Yes, yes. I'm coming right over.
Looks busy... wait, she's looking after people besides me, all by herself...
Manager
Nene-kun, about processing this slip...
Even the manager!?
Good job. So, how is work？
It's embarrassing, but it's pretty tough...
Hehe, but you're doing well for someone who just started, you know？
I guess... By the way, are there other new people besides me？
No, the rest of the staff has all been here for a while. Why？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you were looking after people besides me too. What about them？
Oh, those girls？
Well, they know what to do and can do the basics on their own, but...
But？
Well, if there's some trouble, or something they don't know, they always come to me...
And I'm only about a year senior to them...
Hey, why do you think that is？
Well, I have no idea...
I see... I wonder why...
(But somehow, I think I know why...)
All right, I'll work hard again today！
Customer
Hey, excuse me～.
Ah！ Um, I'm so sorry！
Anegasaki
What's wrong...？ Ah！
We're very sorry, ma'am. Are your clothes and belongings all right？
Ah, um... Er...
We'll clean this up right away and bring you a replacement. We're terribly sorry.
Mm, it's fine～.
Sorry...
Eh...？ Oh, don't worry, don't worry.
But... I'm the one who messed up, and ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ had to apologize too...
That's not right, okay？ To the customer, you and I are both staff, right？
But...
Geez... don't get so down over something like this.
Everyone makes a mistake or two, right？
...Yeah.
Hehe. You're still new, so it's okay if you make lots of mistakes.
But you have to learn from them, okay？
You're allowed to make mistakes because everyone believes you'll grow from them.
...You too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Of course. I think highly of how honestly you take things in.
You do what I teach you without any fuss, right？
That's actually really impressive, you know？
...You think so？
Yes. I guarantee it. Big sis says so, so you can believe it.
I see... Okay, I believe you. And I'll work hard so I don't cause you trouble again.
Hehe, that's how it should be.
All right, I'll work hard again today！
Anegasaki
Eek！ ...Huh？ What was that!?
In front of the restaurant... a traffic accident!?
Eeeeh!?
What do we do？ The customers are shaken, and the manager's out at a meeting...
It's all right. I just called for an ambulance.
Eh？ Ah... With your cell phone？
Yeah. I dashed into the kitchen and did it on the spot... I did it without asking, was that bad？
No. Good call. Just what I'd expect from someone I have high hopes for.
Phew... I think that's the end of it？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, how did it go？
Ah... thanks for earlier. I didn't know what was going to happen.
No problem. But it wasn't a serious accident, right？
Yeah.
But that's a boy for you. I was a little impressed, I guess？
I'm not really at the age to be called a "boy" anymore...
I see. Hehe, sorry. You're a fine man, aren't you？
Being called that is also...
Well then！
Let's work hard for a bit longer until closing.
All right, I'll work hard again today！
Anegasaki
Thank you very much.
Whew... Good work. The peak is finally over.
There were a lot of customers today... Ah, I'll bus that table.
Really？ Thank you. Hehe...
What is it？
You've picked up most of the job. You're handling the register properly too.
It's all thanks to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Really？ Then maybe I'm off duty soon？ Big sis is a little lonely.
That's not true.
Hehe, kidding, kidding. I need you to become a full-fledged worker soon, after all.
Full-fledged...
Ah, I know. Hey, shall we celebrate you becoming full-fledged？
Celebrate？
We get off at the same time tonight, right？ If you have some time after, how about getting some food？
...Just ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ and me？
It's fine if you don't want to... Sorry. Did I get ahead of myself？
It's not that I don't want to or anything.
Then, okay？
Yeah, of course.
Hehe, I'm glad. Then it's decided.
Welcome！ ...See you later, then.
Anegasaki
Sorry about this place...
Don't worry. It's fine.
Haah... To think I got my favorite restaurant's day off wrong...
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ might be surprisingly clumsy sometimes...)
Hm？ I feel a pitying gaze...
Th-that's not it！
Well then, since today is a celebration, this will be my treat.
Eh？ It's fine. You don't need to...
Don't hold back. At work and at school, you're my junior.
No, I can't accept that
Okay, but next time's on me
Then I accept, thanks
You may be my senior, but we're only one year apart, and we're both students.
...Huh, you're pretty sensible.
Come on, don't tease me...
No, that's not it. I just honestly thought so.
Oh, trying to look cool.
Th-that's not it...
Hehe. In due time then, okay？
(Feels like she's going to brush it off...)
That's right. Be honest with big sis, okay？
Yeah, sorry...
Geez, it's not something you need to apologize for, right？ Hehe, so cute▼
Thanks for today. And sorry. I invited you, and it ended up so hectic.
No, thank you.
Hehe. Well, it was your full-fledged celebration, after all.
Ah, oh no, look at the time... I had fun today, thanks. See you.
(A meal alone with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... even if it was fast food.)
Okay, I don't have work today. What should I do...？
The arcade, or browsing at the bookstore... sleeping at home is productive too... so busy.
Hm？ Isn't that... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Anegasaki
Oh, you're welcome.
No, no, no need to thank me... Okay, bye-bye, granny.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Ah...
What were you doing just now？
An old lady asked me for directions, so I showed her the way.
Huh, that's so very ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, somehow.
So very me？
Yeah. At Dixie's or around town, you're "dependable Nene-san."
I guess... before that, a tourist asked me to take their photo, and before that, a lost kid grabbed the hem of my skirt...
...At that point, it's like a manga...
I do like being relied on, and doing things for people, but...
...I'm really not that together of a person...
No way...
It's true, you know？
Do you sometimes want to lean on someone too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Huh？
If so, I mean... when you get tired of being relied on, maybe ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ could lean on someone too？
Others... Like... You？
Me... I might not be up to it. Haha.
Geez, don't push yourself...
But, you know. You might be the first person who's ever said that to me...
Well, this is where I turn off...
Okay, see you...
(The real ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, huh...)
All right, I'll work hard again today！
Phew, finally a break...
Anegasaki
Sorry. Got a minute？
Yeah, I just started my break. What is it？
Well... The manager asked me to come up with ideas for a new menu.
Even though you're a part-timer？
Because I'm a part-timer. You know, I'm a high schooler too, after all？
Oh, so a new menu that's popular with high school students？
Right. They asked if there's a menu item that would attract both boys and girls.
Both boys and girls...？ Might be hard.
And when I said it'd be hard by myself... well.
Are you saying...
Right, help me out？ I thought I'd lean on you right away, hehe.
First, they want us to eat what's popular with high schoolers... and tell them if it could work at our restaurant.
They'll even give us money for it.
Huh.
I'll take care of reporting it, so all you need to do is give your honest opinion.
Just eat and give my opinion... I could do that.
Geez, it's still work, you know？
Yeah, I understand...
Hehe, it's next Sunday. Are you free？
Yeah, I'm free.
I'll give you the details later. Bye.
(Sunday, just the two of us... is this...？)
Huh... this sakura mochi isn't very sweet.
Anegasaki
But it's not bland either, right？
Yeah, the aroma spreads in your mouth. It's like... spring？
Phew, I think this should do.
I really just ate and gave my opinion. Is that okay？
It's okay, it's okay. I'll take care of the rest.
Listening to you today, I was thinking...
Hmm？
It really doesn't feel like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is only one year older than me...
Is... that so？
Yeah. You've got knowledge, drive, and the way you approach work... I can't believe you're a student part-timer like me...
...Really？
Hey, what kind of person do you see me as？
A devoted woman, I'd say
A strict big sister
Someone who spoils me
Hmm... I see. So you like being doted on like that？
Th-that's not what I meant...
Aww, that hurts. I thought I was being gentle with you.
You're pretty strict at work, you've got that side too...
Saying that, you're scheming something, aren't you？
N-No, I'm not.
You were a big help today.
Nah, I wasn't much help.
Hehe, that's not true？
Somehow, today was like... a date, huh？
Eh!?
Well, I'll get going？ Bye-bye...
(That surprised me...)
(Still, that sad look when she asked me that... what was that about...)
Anegasaki
Whoa... it's packed.
Didn't think we'd be scouting a ramen shop...
Yes. Apparently their chilled ramen is really good.
It's definitely good... so this is what happens when a good ramen shop gets serious about chilled ramen...
Hehe, it'd be hard for our restaurant to copy, huh？
But, depending on how we tweak it...
Eh？ What is it？
I can't help thinking you might be way older than me.
Is that so？
Yeah. Knowledge, drive, and today's research too... I can't believe you're a student part-timer.
...I see...
Hey, what kind of person do you think I am？
You'd dote on me
You'd scold me strictly
You'd let me be spoiled
I see～. So that's what you like？
T-That's not how I meant it...
Eh～？ Haven't I been nice to you？
But when it comes to work you're strict, and you scold me properly.
Hehe, you want to be spoiled？
It's not about me！
Thanks for today. Thanks to you, I can make a proper report.
I didn't...
Hehe, you did your job, you know？
Come to think of it, would you call something like this a date？
Eh!?
Ah, I have to go... See you later.
(That surprised me...)
(Still, that sad look when she asked me that... what was that about...)
Anegasaki
This place is famous for making pasta with seasonal ingredients. Now it's Fall, so mushrooms would taste great.
...Um. Don't you think we might be out of place here？
Not really？ Surprisingly, students from our school come here a lot.
I see...
As expected, or whatever... this isn't going to be a useful reference, is it？
Hmm～, but if we could at least capture the atmosphere somehow...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ really is grown-up, huh.
What's this all of a sudden？
When I'm with you, I feel like a kid...
That's...
You know so much, you've got drive, and you handle work like you're not even a high schooler.
I knew it...
From your perspective, what kind of person do you see me as？
You'd dote on me
You'd scold me strictly
You'd let me be spoiled
Hmm, so that's what you're hoping for.
T-That's not how I meant it...
How mean. I'm supposed to be gentle with you, you know？
But you draw clear lines, and you can be properly strict at work.
Geez, so you wanted to be spoiled... hehe▼
That's not what I meant...
Thanks. With your help, I think I'll be able to write a good report.
I didn't do anything...
Hehe, you were a help, you know？
Doesn't today feel kind of like a date？
Eh!?
See you later. Bye-bye...
(That surprised me...)
(Still, that sad look when she asked me that... what was that about...)
Huh, so there's a place like this...
Anegasaki
Nice atmosphere, right？ A restaurant on the lakeshore. This lasagna is winter-only.
Eating warm food while gazing at the winter lake... Hehe, how wonderful.
Yeah, it's good. I might want to come back here...
If we could reproduce this taste in a family restaurant, it'd be amazing.
If we were going to try, let's see...
I realized it again today...
What is it？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ really is grown-up, after all.
You know everything, you've got drive, and your work ethic puts working adults to shame...
That's not true...
...How do I look to you？
The totally devoted type
The type who scolds me
The type who spoils me
Hmm, so that's what you're hoping for.
T-That's not how I meant it...
How mean. I'm supposed to be gentle with you, you know？
But you draw clear lines, and you can be properly strict at work.
Geez, so you wanted to be spoiled... hehe.
That's not what I meant...
Thanks. With your help, I think I'll be able to write a good report.
I didn't do anything...
Hehe, you were a help, you know？
Come to think of it, is this a date？
Eh!?
See you later. Bye-bye...
(That surprised me...)
(Still, that sad look when she asked me that... what was that about...)
All right, I'll work hard again today！
Phew, done with the trash.
Anegasaki
Ah, taking out the trash？
Yeah, and you？
I'm on break, so I came out for some air... Hey, got a sec？
Yeah, I'm also going on break now. Want to go to the break room？
No, right here...
？ Sure...
Sorry about the other day, saying weird stuff...
Last time...？
When we went to research the new menu for the manager.
Ah...
"What do you think of me？"... That's an awkward question, when I think about it...
You can forget it, okay？
...What I'm more worried about is how sad ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ looked when asking that...
Eh...
If something's bothering you...
Geez！ Don't get cocky！
I was just teasing you.
What!?
Because you make such a cute face when you're flustered.
No way...
Yes, that face. Hehe, so cute▼
Ah, I have to get back...
Hm？
I might be unreliable and no use to you, but...
If being treated as the big sister all the time is hard on you...
...Geez, saying that with such a cute face...
Thanks. See you later.
(The sad ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ and the ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ just now...)
(Which one is real...)
I came to the station since I was bored, but there's nothing interesting...
Oh right, the manager gave me tickets to a preview screening...
(Mm, that was fun.)
Anegasaki
Huh？
Ah... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
What a coincidence. I thought that back looked familiar.
Um... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you were at the screening too？
Yeah. I watched it too, the manager gave me a ticket... wait, don't tell me.
Yeah, I got mine from the manager too...
Hehe, well, then I guess it's not really a coincidence.
Maybe not. How was the movie？
Yes, it was fun.
I see. It's horror, though...
...Is it strange for a girl to like horror...？
It's not weird, but...
Really？ Good, because I was thinking of seeing it again.
That much？ It was fun, and it might be worth seeing again...
Ah, hey. Then, shall we see it together？
Together？
Ah, do you not want to？
No, not at all.
Then, okay？ A movie, together...
Yeah, I'd love to.
...Hehe.
Hm？
This time it's not on the way home from work, and not for work either, huh？
Ah...
Ah, sorry, I have to go. ...See you？
(This time, it might really be a date...)
All right, I'll work hard again today！
Thank you very much.
Otori
Hey, hey, you're a total veteran now, huh？
Huh, not really...
Komari
Yes you are～. Teach me stuff I don't know, 'kay？
Geez, you rely on people too much.
But Nene-san doesn't give me any attention lately～.
Eh？
Anegasaki
Good work.
Ah, good work.
You're on break after this, right？ Got a minute？
Ah, yeah...
See, see～ I told you so～.
Eh～, seriously～？
Hey, what about your next day off？
What about it？
You know... that movie from the preview. It's out now, you know？
Oh, is it？ Then we have to go.
...We "have to"？
Yeah. I mean, we promised, right？
Ah... Yeah. That's right...
What？ What's wrong？
No... right. We promised. We have to go.
Then how about next Sunday？ You're off too, right, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Yes, that works. Let's do that.
Okay. Well then, back to work.
Yeah, let's.
Um, row D... D15 and 16... ah, here. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, over here.
Anegasaki
Ah... Right in the middle.
We already know the story, but the visuals were pretty fun, so I bet we'll enjoy it again.
Yeah, that's right...
...You seem kind of down？
No, I'm not...
Really？
Say...
Hm？
Do you talk with those girls a lot？
Those girls？
The two at Dixie's.
Ah. Yeah, I guess. Fairly often.
We go to different schools, but we're the same year, so all sorts of stuff. Like how far along our classes are.
I see, the same year...
What's wrong？
Hey, what do you think of those two？
Eh!?
Hmm, let's see...
I think they're cute
A bit of a handful
Kind of childish
They're cute. They're like classmates, easy to talk to.
...I see, so you like cute...
Ah, it's not about liking or not... it's more like I want to look out for them...
They're good kids, but a bit of a handful. They lean on others a lot...
I see, so you prefer people who take charge themselves？
Maybe. People who lead everyone around them might be cool.
They're good kids, but a little childish for our age.
Hmm, so you like girls who are more mature？
I wonder... I think I long for the kind of kindness that forgives anything...
Ah, it's starting.
Yeah...
That was great after all！
Yeah, even when you know "here it comes！" you still brace yourself.
Hehe, I'm glad I invited you.
Same here.
Worrying all by myself, how silly...
No, it's nothing.
Hey, today's... date. Were you looking forward to it？
Hmm？ Yeah, of course.
I see, then that's fine... See you.
(That's the usual ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, right？)
Komari
Eh～, no way～, and then？
So then, the teacher's face was like...
Anegasaki
Hey, break's almost over, you know？
Otori
Ah, okaaay.
Nene-san's scaaary～.
Well, I'd better go too.
All right, I'll work hard again today！
(It's really busy today...)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！ Are you okay？
Ah, yeah. Sorry.
Ah... freshly washed plates are slippery, I have to be careful.
Yeah, you're right...
What？
Nothing. Just thinking you're the more dependable one now.
That's because ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ trained me well.
Geez, getting cheeky...
Anyway, we need to clean up the broken plate...
Ah, I'll take care of it. It's fine.
It's rare for Nene-san to break a plate. Are you all right？
That's right, are you hurt？
Yes, I'm fine, so...
You look pale, don't push yourself...
...That's right. I think I'll rest for a bit. I'll be right back...
All right, I'll work hard again today！
Anegasaki
Welcome.
Please wait a moment.
Thank you very much.
Yeah, same old ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Phew, I'm beat...
Good work.
Hey. I've been feeling a really intense gaze today, you know？
That's...
Did I make you worry？
...Yeah, maybe.
Aww, I've failed as a big sister, making you worry.
Sorry...
Geez, it's nothing to apologize for.
But...
I've decided not to let it bother me.
Let what？
All sorts of things.
You know, I was worrying about a lot of things.
But I've decided not to let any of it bother me anymore.
Why？
Because I realized worrying was pointless.
After all, I'm me, and you're you, right？
Y-Yeah...
Bye...
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, and I'm me...)
(Meaning me...？)
Anegasaki
Ah, good work.
Say...
Hm？
About what you said the other day.
The other day？
About something worrying you...
Oh, that. Curious？
That's... Of course.
That was about... our date.
I was really looking forward to it. But you said "we have to go" and "because we promised."
Like it was an obligation, like you had no choice...
Sorry, I didn't mean it like that...
Yes, I know that... but, also, well...
You were having so much fun with those girls. The ones in your year...
Well... they're coworkers...
Right, that's only natural...
But, you know, that's me.
One offhand word from you can shake my heart so much.
When I see you having fun with girls your age, I get unbearably jealous.
But you know, I decided to accept that part of myself.
Because that's who I am...
Anegasaki
Good work.
Um...
What？
About what you said the other day.
The other day？
About something worrying you...
Oh, that... you're curious？
That's... Of course.
That was about our date. With you.
I was looking forward to it so much.
But you were all "we have to go" and "because we promised."
Geez, shouldn't you go because you want to, not because you have to？
Sorry, I didn't mean it like that...
Hehe, but it's okay now.
Seeing you having fun with those girls in your year... I didn't like it...
Well... they're coworkers...
Right, that's only natural.
But that's who I am.
It seems I hate the idea of someone else taking you from me.
That's why I've decided.
Anegasaki
Good work.
Um...
Wha-at？
About what you said the other day.
The other day？ What was that？
About something worrying you...
Hehe, that？ You're curious？
Well... of course.
It was about... our date. With you.
I was really looking forward to it, you know.
And you said "we have to go" and "because we promised"...
I wondered why you couldn't just say "let's go" because you wanted to.
Sorry, I didn't mean it like that...
Hehe. But it's fine now.
When I saw you having fun with those girls in your year, I just, you know.
Well... they're coworkers...
Yeah, that's only natural.
So I decided not to let that bother me either.
Whatever you say to me, whatever you do, I'll just take it all in myself.
I've made up my mind.
